visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair and a grey t-shirt is speaking directly to the camera in a selfie-style shot. The handle moves but the door remains shut. (3) The woman is sitting on the floor in a tiled hallway outside the black door, holding a gift box and looking at her smartphone with a weary expression. (4) The door opens slightly to reveal an older woman in a pink shirt looking out. (5) The woman in the grey shirt is back on camera, pointing a thumb behind her toward the hallway where her mother is seen waving and walking away with a bag. (6) The woman is shown holding her phone to her ear, simulating a call. A graphic overlay of the Philips 702-FVP smart lock appears on the screen. A close-up shows a 4-inch screen on the interior part of the lock displaying a live video feed of the mother outside. (9) The mother enters the door and looks at the new lock with a surprised smile. The daughter greets her enthusiastically. (10) The two women are sitting on a plaid couch. The daughter is holding a smartphone, pointing at the screen and explaining features to her mother. (11) Screen recordings show the mobile app interface with video logs and temporary password settings. (12) Close-up of the mother using her finger on the lock's sensor and looking at the exterior camera unit. (13) Promotional graphic appears with price details and product images. (14) The two women make heart gestures with their hands towards the camera, smiling. (15) Final scene shows the daughter trying to sneak into a room with a bowl of food, looking startled as her mother catches her.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement for the Philips 702-FVP smart lock. It frames the product as a practical Mother's Day gift that solves the common problem of forgetting physical keys. By showing the daughter's frustration followed by the mother's joy and the ease of use via the mobile app, it creates an emotional and functional appeal for the product.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, mention of model name 702-FVP, pricing information, and Mother's Day special offer graphics.
